title: Build-time performance budget enforcement
description: Make performance budget checks in the generator fail the build (non-zero exit) instead of just logging. Current budgets: 20,480B gzipped CSS, 500 properties.
acceptance_criteria: Generator exits with non-zero code if maxCssGzipped or maxProperties exceeded
Budget overrides per-theme configurable in foundation JSON
Existing themes still pass (all currently within budgets)

evidence.context: Currently budgets are checked but do not fail the build
